fold_rule: outer family fold is evaluation-only; next cyclic family fold is threshold-calibration-only; remaining three folds join base training
calibration_constraint: maximum 0.5% false-positive rate on combined Phase 9 development plus disjoint Phase 11 calibration fold
selection_rule: among conditions with at most 4/200 out-of-fold false routes in every seed, maximize worst-seed counterfactual exact, then mean exact, then minimize learned parameters
